hints.title: Formula for Trio Degree
hints.text: For three mutually connected vertices (u, v, w), the trio degree is degree[u] + degree[v] + degree[w] - 6.

hints.title: Matrix Adjacency Representation
hints.text: Store edges in an n x n adjacency boolean matrix for O(1) edge existence checks.

hints.title: Edge-Centric Trio Search
hints.text: Iterate over all directed edge pairs (u, v) with u < v, then check common neighbors w > v.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all triplets without fast adjacency checks is slow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Adjacency matrix allows fast O(1) triangle testing over 400 vertices in ~10^7 operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate subtracts 6 from the sum of node degrees to eliminate mutual internal edges.
